# NestedNotOperators

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `NestedNotOperatorsInspection`

Stacking logical-not operators (`!!$x`, `!!!$x`) is a cryptic way to write a
boolean cast or a single negation. An even number of `!` is a `(bool)` cast, an
odd number is one `!`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6,7,8} [Before]
<?php
$ok   = !!$token;
$off  = !!!$token;
$six  = !!!!!!$token;
$both = !!($m > $n);
$neg  = !!! ($p instanceof Item);
$wrap = !( !(count($list)) );
$deep = !(!(!(($flag))));
$one  = !$token;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$ok   = (bool)$token;
$off  = !$token;
$six  = (bool)$token;
$both = (bool)($m > $n);
$neg  = !($p instanceof Item);
$wrap = (bool)count($list);
$deep = !$flag;
$one  = !$token;
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;(bool)$token&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;!$token&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;(bool)$token&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;(bool)($m &gt; $n)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;!($p instanceof Item)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;(bool)count($list)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 8: Simplify the stacked negations to &#39;!$flag&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "NestedNotOperators": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore NestedNotOperators

/**
 * @noinspection NestedNotOperatorsInspection
 */
```
